title: Photodetector based on bis-2,6-[2-(2-oxoindolin-3-ylidene)malononitrile]naphthalene derivatives/zinc oxide nanorod heterostructures with machine vision observation and artificial intelligence pattern recognition
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43763-43773
